scope: Source-qualified SEC molar-mass moments and author-reported dispersity of existing polymer identities,including explicit reproduced-origin provenance;not spectral/chromatographic computation.

molar_mass_moments.meaning: Reported SEC measurement-result moments,not specimen mass,density,replication or number of molecules. Experimental reference does not mean new experiment in reproducing publication.

dispersity.formula: Source explicitly defines Mw/Mn;retain original orderedmoment roles. No software division,input-pair inference,error propagation or replacement with ratio of printedmeans.

reported_values_and_uncertainty.moments: Finite strictly positive source scalar;preserve native unit,scale and precision. SelectedMw6.96 SD0.38,Mn6.45 SD0.32 bothten5g/mol,not unscaledg/mol.
reported_values_and_uncertainty.dispersity: Finite scalar >=1 admitted in first closed role;source anomalies below1 remain frozen outsideadmission for separate adjudication,never clamp or rewrite. No uppercap.
reported_values_and_uncertainty.absolute_sd: Only source-explicit SD with reportedmean;same role and source unit/scale ascenter. Nonnegative finite;SD not clipped tocentral domain or treated as bound.
reported_values_and_uncertainty.relative_measures: Source-relativeCV remains percent;not dedicatedratio or source-molar-mass amplitude. NoSD/CI/n inferred from methodname,R2 orduplicate.
reported_values_and_uncertainty.source_statistics: Table2 itself explicitly reportsmean±SD. Moment weighting is different from replicate aggregation;meanPDI not asserted equal ratioofmeans. Exactn and batch count unknown.

No newmaterial/scientificcoverage count for the reproducedexperiment;primaryfulltext can stayunknown when genuinelyunavailable,without asserting originalmethod orlicense.

source_cell_and_cross_publication_dedup.across_publications: A confirmedsameoriginaldatum must be onecuratedrecord with multipleprovenance links/citations,not a new independentexperiment. OriginalDOI alone cannot merge allrows orallmoments.
